description: Exact Q4 Galerkin solve of -div(a grad u) = 1, u = 0 on the boundary, scored against Li et al.'s released solutions with the benchmark's per-instance relative L2: the score of a perfectly trained physics-only model (the exact minimiser of a loss on this discretization).
data_source: Li et al.'s piececonst_r421_N1024_smooth2.mat, first 200 instances, native s=421
